{{Quote|<nowiki>Galaxy = needs T7 + Jedi // T7 = ready for next mission</nowiki>|translated=1|T7-O1|<ref name="Slaver's Redemption">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Slaver's Redemption}}</ref>}}
'''T7-O1''', known affectionately as '''Teeseven''' or '''T7''', was a [[T7-series astromech droid|T7-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] active during the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Manufactured by [[Duwani Mechanical Products/Legends|Duwani Mechanical Products]] sometime before [[3843 BBY]], the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] did not undergo a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]] during his entire lifetime, allowing him to develop a strong personality and preserve the memories of the dozen or so partners he worked with throughout the [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Originally a repair and pilot [[Droid/Legends|droid]], Teeseven began working with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the years before the Great Galactic War as the partner of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]], and he went undercover for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] on multiple occasions during the conflict. Surviving the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] and the fall of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] at the end of the war, Teeseven served as a reconnaissance droid for the Order on their homeworld of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] for much of the Cold War before teaming up with a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi]] who was the former apprentice of Jedi Master [[Orgus Din]].

Alongside his friend and the Jedi's apprentice [[Kira Carsen]], Teeseven played a pivotal role in halting the plot of the Sith Lord [[Darth Angral]] to assault the Republic using stolen [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]], and after the Knight received the title of Hero of Tython the droid continued to travel [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] with his partners. Teeseven's service with the Hero of Tython eventually culminated in a plan to capture the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] himself, and the droid accompanied the Hero of Tython during an [[Dromund Kaas operation|assault]] on the Sith [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The two managed to gain entry to the [[Dark Temple|Emperor's throne room]] and defeated the Emperor in a fierce confrontation. Afterwards, Teeseven and the rest of the Hero of Tython's companions were awarded the [[Cross of Glory]] for their pivotal role in ending the threat of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
===Early history===
{{Quote|T7! Prep the ion cannons!|Nico Okarr to T7-O1|<ref name="Return">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/return|text="Return"|int=Return (cinematic trailer)}}</ref>}}
A [[T7-series astromech droid]] produced by [[Duwani Mechanical Products/Legends|Duwani Mechanical Products]], T7-O1 was constructed sometime before 3843 BBY<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> as a standard factory-spec [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]]. Over the next century and a half, Teeseven passed from owner to owner&mdash;whom the droid referred to as "partners"&mdash;without ever undergoing a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]]. This led Teeseven to develop a personality and preserved the droid's memories of all of his former partners.<ref name="Slaver's Redemption" /> Approximately one hundred years after his creation,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Teeseven was assigned as a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] legislation analyst<ref name="The Traitor">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|The Traitor}}</ref> under [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Oodora]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="Holonet" /> Oodora promoted the astromech after his first year, and Teeseven soon became the Senator's campaign manager and speech writer throughout Oodora's four consecutive terms. When the Senator retired after twenty years of working with Teeseven,<ref name="The Traitor" /> the droid began working with a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] named [[Shafu]]&mdash;who, unbeknownst to Teeseven, was a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]].<ref name="Slaver's Redemption" />

[[File:T7_fixes_ship.png|thumb|left|250px|T7-O1 at work on Okarr's ship.]]
Teeseven served Shafu faithfully as a [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]], piloting the Rodian's ship and never entering the cargo hold. However, Shafu was eventually captured by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Ven Zallow]], who convinced Shafu to turn over a new leaf instead of turning him over to the authorities. At Zallow's request, Shafu became a confidential informant for the Order, and in gratitude the Rodian gave Teeseven to the Jedi.<ref name="Slaver's Redemption" /> By [[3681 BBY]], Zallow had sent Teeseven undercover to work with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Nico Okarr]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and the droid served as the [[Human/Legends|human's]] mechanic and aide on his [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock light freighter]]<ref name="Return" /> ''[[Redshifter]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> While attempting to smuggle [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifacts off the planet, Okarr and Teeseven were captured by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces over the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] homeworld of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], and the Republic arrested Okarr and impounded the smuggler's ship with Teeseven aboard the [[Korriban's orbital security station|Republic space station]] in the [[Horuset system]].<ref name="Return" />

However, Okarr's transfer to a holding cell was interrupted by the arrival of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A massive fleet arrived in-system and launched an offensive against the station, intending to [[Battle of Korriban|retake]] their homeworld. As the smuggler's ship was the only one fast enough to escape the Sith fighters, Jedi Knight [[Satele Shan]] and her [[Kao Cen Darach|master]] decided to use it to escape in order to warn the Republic. Teeseven had been on-board the ship performing maintenance as the hangar came under assault by Sith forces, and the smuggler instructed him to prepare the ship's weapons in preparation for their escape. The smuggler and his passengers, including Teeseven, were ultimately able to escape their pursuers and bring word to the Republic of the oncoming Sith threat.<ref name="Return" />

Leaving Okarr's service sometime after Korriban and returning to Master Zallow, Teeseven worked with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] throughout much of the [[Great Galactic War]]. By that time, he had worked with a total of eleven partners, including Zallow, Oodora, a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]], [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]], Shafu, a Senatorial aide, and Okarr. Around [[3663 BBY]],<ref name="Time SIS">{{TOR_dates|1}} Subtracting 20 years from 3643 BBY results in a date of 3663 BBY.</ref> Zallow lent Teeseven to the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] for a single mission. The intelligence agency sent the droid undercover to protect a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Unidentified Muun ambassador|ambassador]] from the secretive [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] guild known as the [[GenoHaradan]]. During the assignment, Teeseven was successfully able to detect the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] in the crowd and discharged a stun bolt, but the assassin escaped into the crowd. The ambassador retired in fear, leaving Teeseven depressed and believing that he never truly completed his mission.<ref name="The Assassination" />

===Service to the Order===
====The fall of Coruscant====
{{Quote|Tee-seven?''"<br />"''You know this astromech?''"<br />"''It was Master Zallow's droid.|Aryn Leneer and Zeerid Korr|<ref name="Deceived N" />}}
In [[3653 BBY]], Teeseven was present on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with Ven Zallow when the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] was attacked by a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] strike force under the leadership of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]]. Zallow ordered his astromech companion to stay hidden and record the battle in case of a Jedi defeat, though the droid emerged briefly to warn the Jedi Master of Darth Malgus' approach during the fighting.<ref name="Deceived T" /> Teeseven returned to his hiding place and watched as Zallow was [[Death/Legends|slain]] in battle with Malgus, and he escaped into the tunnels beneath the Temple as the battle turned against the Jedi. Teeseven attempted to return to Zallow's body after the fighting ended and managed to recover his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], but the Sith planted explosives and the droid was forced to retreat deeper into the lower levels of Coruscant as the Temple was brought down. A damaged Teeseven remained there for quite some time before he encountered Zallow's former apprentice [[Aryn Leneer]] and the smuggler [[Zeerid Korr]], who were attempting to find out who had killed Zallow. After explaining what had transpired at the Temple, Teeseven accompanied the pair to the Temple's backup surveillance station, and he was able to restore power to the systems in order to show Leneer recordings of the Temple's fall. He paused and resumed the recording as per Leneer's instructions, allowing her to discover the identity of Zallow's killer, and he copied the recording for Leneer to peruse later when the trio departed.<ref name="Deceived N" />

T7 and the two Humans hid in an abandoned apartment building after leaving the Temple ruins, and he stayed with Leneer while Korr scouted the nearby [[Liston Spaceport]]. Leneer departed during the night despite T7's protests, and the droid later followed the Jedi Knight to the Temple with Korr when the smuggler returned. There, the two found Darth Malgus and Leneer embroiled in a [[Duel in the ruins of the Jedi Temple|fierce duel]], but Korr interrupted the fight in fear of her falling to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and helped Leneer escape. Leneer then decided to pursue Malgus' [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] lover, [[Eleena Daru]], in her quest for revenge, and as part of her plan the trio fell from their speeder onto the top of the spaceport. Leneer slowed T7's descent with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and the droid hacked into the spaceport's systems and triggered the facility's fire suppression and safety systems with a false signal that tricked the network's sensors into detecting a fuel gas leak. As a result, evacuation alarms were triggered in [[Landing Bay 16-B]]&mdash;the hangar used by the shuttles belonging to Daru and her team&mdash;and the hangar's launch doors openned, allowing Leneer to enter and attack Daru. At Korr's orders, T7 hacked into the [[Dragonfly-class Imperial drop ship|''Dragonfly''-class dropship]] [[Razor (Dragonfly-class)|''Razor'']] in the landing bay, but the droid decided to remain behind with Leneer after she decided not to kill Daru. Teeseven hid in the shadows of the hangar while the Knight confronted Malgus, and the two departed Coruscant aboard Daru's shuttle after Leneer threatened the Twi'lek to ensured her own safety.<ref name="Deceived N" />

====The Tython uprising====
While Leneer left the Order and traveled to the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to live with Korr,<ref name="Deceived N" /> Teeseven returned to the Order's service,<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> and when the Jedi Order left Coruscant in [[3650 BBY/Legends|3650 BBY]],<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> Teeseven accompanied them to the Order's long-lost homeworld of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Teeseven served as a reconnaissance droid for the Order over the next few [[Standard year/Legends|years]], scouting Tython's wilderness and identifying hazards. In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Teeseven was sent out along with nineteen other droids as long-range probes, but he was captured by a group of [[Flesh Raider]]s, a violent [[Species/Legends|species]] native to Tython, near the Flesh Raider-controlled [[Tythos Ridge]] region. Locked inside a weapons cache in the [[Upper Hollows]] cave system, Teeseven faked deactivation and recorded a meeting between the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Callef]] and a [[Bengel Morr|hooded figure]] whom Callef called Master.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

When the [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] [[Raid on the Flesh Raider weapons cache|raided the weapons cache]] for the [[Pilgrims]] of [[Kalikori village]], the Padawan freed T7 and removed the [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]] that the Flesh Raiders had attached to the droid. In thanks, T7 showed the Jedi the recording it had secretly made while pretending to be deactivated: a [[Bengel Morr|hooded figure]], giving orders to the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Callef]]<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />&mdash;whom the Padawan had defeated earlier<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Attack of the Flesh Raiders|Tython}}</ref>&mdash;and the Flesh Raiders. Callef referred to the figure as his master, and the pair seemed determined to destroy the Jedi Order.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

Having discovered the source of the Flesh Raiders' sudden increase in violence, the Padawan and the other Jedi set out to stop Bengel Morr and prevent further casualties.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Face of the Enemy|Tython}}</ref> T7's later accompanied the Padawan in rescuing Orgus Din after the latter was lured into a trap and captured by Bengel Morr. Morr revealed himself as Orgus Din's former apprentice and was assumed to have been killed during the Sacking of Coruscant, and his rage at his perceived weakness of the Jedi left him seeking vengeance on the Order. Before he could slay Orgus Din, the Padawan and T7 intervened, defeating Morr and saving the Jedi Master. The Padawan was then elevated to the rank of Knight for the Jedi's role in ending the Flesh Raider threat, and T7 looked on as the newly promoted Knight constructed their first lightsaber. When the Knight was then dispatched to the capital of Coruscant to aid Jedi Master [[Bela Kiwiiks]] and her [[Kira Carsen|Padawan]] in dealing with a new threat, T7-O1 decided to remain with the Knight as the droid felt they were a formidable team.<ref name="The Jedi Envoy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Jedi Envoy|Coruscant}}</ref>

===Partners and heroes===
On Coruscant, T7-O1, the Knight and Orgus Din were brought up to speed on the situation by Master Kiwiiks. They were introduced to Republic scientist [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Eli Tarnis]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]], who informed them that the plans for a Republic [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] known as the [[Planet Prison]] had been stolen, and the Jedi had been called in to help retrieve them. Working with Kira Carsen and Agent [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], T7-O1 and the Knight tracked the stolen plans first to a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Vistis Garn|slicer]] then to the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminial syndicate. The mission then became more complicated as the two learned that Tarnis had been kidnapped by Black Sun. After one failed attempt to rescue Tarnis, T7-O1 and the Knight were informed by General Suthra that the stolen plans had also contained information about every Republic superweapon in development, not just the Planet Prison. Masters Din and Kiwiiks, as well as Agent Galen then departed Coruscant to secure the sites of the compromised superweapons while the Knight and T7-O1 launched an assault on the headquarters of Black Sun in order to rescue Tarnis.<ref name="Stolen Secrets">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Stolen Secrets|Coruscant}}</ref><ref name="Kidnapped!">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Kidnapped!|Coruscant}}</ref>

With the aid of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], T7-O1 and the Knight fought their way to the Black Sun command center, where they found the Black Sun [[Salarr|leader]] in a holocall with Tarnis, who revealed himself to be a Sith Lord. After defeating Salarr, T7-O1 and the Knight were told by Carsen that Tarnis had stolen the Planet Prison prototype and intended to use it on Coruscant. The three then pursued the Sith Lord first to the [[Justicar territory|Justicars' Sector]], where they found the murdered engineering team behind the Planet Prison, then to the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], where they found Tarnis in a call with four Sith Lords, including his father, [[Darth Angral]]. Tarnis was slain by the Knight in combat and the activation of the Planet Prison was narrowly averted. Infuriated by his son's death, Angral promised to have vengeance on the Republic and the Knight in particular.<ref name="Kidnapped!" /><ref name="Tracking Down">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Tracking Down the Traitor|Coruscant}}</ref>

[[File:T7_and_the_Emperor.png|thumb|left|250px|T7-O1 battling the Sith Emperor's phantoms with the Hero of Tython]]
Upon reporting in to General Suthra and Grand Master [[Satele Shan]], the Knight was told that Din, Kiwiiks and Galen had all failed to report in, and General Suthra feared that Angral had already seized control of the superweapons. The general then gave the Knight a [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]] for use as their personal starship as well as the location of one of Angral's bases on the planet of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], and asked the Knight to look into it. With Kira Carsen in tow as the Knight's new Padawan, the group then departed Coruscant for Ord Mantell. Upon arriving on Ord Mantell, T7-O1 and the Knight made their way to [[Imperial Listening Post|Angral's hidden base]] and [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Desolator crisis)|fought]] their way into the command center of the facility. With the base's defenders dealt with, T7-O1 accessed the facility's databanks and found files indicating that Angral was planning to combine aspects of several Republic superweapon programs into a single project, which was codenamed the "Desolator." The files additionally contained intelligence indicating that Angral had sent agents to various worlds to where Republic superweapons were under development.<ref name="New Intelligence">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|New Intelligence|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

With this information in hand, T7-O1 continued to accompany the Knight as they traveled to the worlds of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in order to chase down Angral's agents and secure the superweapons. As a result of these travels the Knight and his companions rescued Doctor [[Nasan Godera]]<ref name="The Architect of Annihilation">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Architect of Annihilation|Taris}}</ref>
, a former Republic weapons designer and destroyed the prototypes of the [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard Project]],<ref name="The Search for Agent Galen">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Search for Agent Galen|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> the [[Shock Drum]]<ref name="Shock Drum" /> and the [[Death Mark]],<ref name="The Death Mark">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Death Mark|Alderaan}}</ref> each of which was a Republic superweapon seized by Angral's forces, rescuing Agent Galen<ref name="Showdown with Lord Sadic">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Showdown with Lord Sadic|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> and Masters Kiwiiks<ref name="The Sand Demon's Lair">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Sand Demon's Lair|Tatooine}}</ref> and Din<ref name="Siege Mentality">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Siege Mentality|Alderaan}}</ref> in the process. Unfortunately the Knight and his companions learned from General Var Suthra that Angral had already succeeded in combining the superweapons technology into the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]], which he had mounted on his [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|flagship]]. Luckily for them, Din had secretly planted a tracker on the ship. The Knight and his companions pursued Angral to the Republic [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Uphrades]] but arrived to find that the world had already been devastated by Angral's superweapon.<ref name="Uphrades">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Uphrades|Uphrades}}</ref>

Subsequently, the Knights and company learn that Angral was targeting Tython. Upon boarding the ''Oppressor'', T7 split off from the Jedi to disable the ship while they go to face Angral. The confrontation resulted in the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] possessing Kira. But thankfully, Kira was able to break the Emperor's hold over her. The trio then reunited aboard the ''Defender'' and escaped the ''Oppressor''{{'s}} destruction.

===The hunt for the Sith Emperor===
A year later, T7-O1 and Kira came upon his Master, who had been given the title of the Hero of Tython, apparently talking to thin air. The Hero explained that the [[Force ghost/Legends|ghost]] of Orgus Din wanted them to go to Tatooine to rescue Jedi Knight [[Jomar Chul]]. Following their successful rescue, the Hero and the crew became involved in a mission by Jedi Master [[Tol Braga]] to capture and redeem the Sith Emperor. In ordered to complete Braga's preparations, the Hero took on a series of missions to [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], [[Quesh]] and [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Once the Hero had completed those objectives, they went ahead with the mission, despite Chul's warnings that he had foresaw the Hero falling to the dark side.

Chul's vision came to pass when the hero and Braga's strike team confronted the Sith Emperor, who dominated their minds and turned them to the dark side. T7 and the rest of the Hero's crew were imprisoned aboard the Emperor's space stations for months while the Hero underwent Sith training. Thankfully, Din's spirit managed to free the Hero of the Emperor's control, who in turn free Kira from being tortured. T7, along with the Hero's new companions, [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]] and Sergeant [[Fideltin Rusk]] were freed by Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], the [[Emperor's Wrath]]. Though everyone was puzzled by Scourge's actions, the Sith explained that a vision he had centuries ago motivated him to rebel against the Emperor.

===Thwarting the Sith Emperor's ritual===
Returning to Tython, Scourge revealed to the Jedi Council that the Emperor was plotting to consume all life in the galaxy to fuel his supposed immortality in a powerful ritual. To thwart the Emperor's plans, the Hero and their crew traveled to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], [[Voss]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to stop the Emperor's servants from killing countless innocent lives to begin the ritual, as well as redeeming the fallen members of their strike team. Their efforts weakened the Emperor, at which the Republic decided to strike at [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] so that the Hero could strike him down. While the Republic kept the Imperial Navy occupied, T7 accompanied the Hero to confront the Emperor, as the two of them couldn't be controlled by him.

When the pair confronted the Emperor and engaged him in battle. After seemingly defeating him, Teeseven contacted Scourge, who exclaimed that the Emperor was not yet dead. Before they could do anything, the Emperor's body became shrouded in a cloud of dark side energy, and the Hero heard the Emperor's voice telepathically warning the Jedi that he would take everything and everyone to the grave with him. As the Dark Temple came crashing down around them, the Hero and Teeseven managed to escape back to the ''Defender'' and fled Dromund Kaas.

Upon rendezvousing with the Republic flagship ''Valiant'', Master Satele and Admiral [[Dabrin]] awarded the Hero and crew each the Republic's highest honor: the [[Cross of Glory]].

===Continued travels===
At some point during the Hero's travels, the Jedi Master suddenly had a vision of a far-away jungle planet. Teeseven then approached the Hero, asking if they were referring to [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], as the planet was entered in the ship's navicomputer.

===Rescuing the Outlander===
Sometime after the former Sith Emperor consumed all life on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], the [[Eternal Empire]] [[Eternal Empire conquest|invaded]] the galaxy, during which the Hero of Tython went missing. The Hero's companions searched in vain for their leader but failed and thus went their separate ways.

By [[3631 BBY]], Teeseven teamed up with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Koth Vortena]] to rescue [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] from Emperor [[Arcann]]'s custody. Infiltrating the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] facility on [[Zakuul]], Teeseven aided in the Outlander's escape by creating false alarms throughout the facility, as well as deactivating blaster turrets firing on Koth's shuttle.<ref name="Chapter 3" />

Teeseven remained on Zakuul while the others fled the planet in the ''[[Gravestone]]''. Being a simple droid granted Teeseven some anonymity. Later on, he received a message from the "[[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]]," who had been seeking the ''Gravestone'' and wished to establish a dialogue with its computer, which Teeseven relayed to the Outlander.<ref name="Chapter 7">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=7}}</ref>

[[File:T7-O1_on_the_Gravestone.jpg|thumb|right|250px|T7-O1 works on the ''Gravestone'' during the Battle of Odessen.]]
Teeseven later met with the Outlander and [[Senya Tirall]] upon their return to Zakuul in search of the Lady. Eventually, after slicing relays and interrogating Zakuulans in the Old World, they learned that the only way to get a meet with the Lady was with the [[Heralds of Zildrog]]. Teeseven soon separated from his companions to update Koth on their status and subsequently bore witness to the interrogation and murder of [[Mona Gale]], the Lady's proxy, by the Heralds.<ref name="Chapter 7" />

After recruiting the Lady, revealed to be a droid named [[SCORPIO]], Teeseven returned to Asylum with the Outlander and company. While SCORPIO was working on the ''Gravestone's'' hyperdrive, the Outlander received a summons from the [[Scions of Zakuul|Scion]] [[Heskal]], at which Teeseven volunteered to accompany the Outlander. The meeting turned out to be a trap, as Heskal had invited Arcann to Asylum to fulfill his vision. After Arcann and the Outlander's duel was interrupted by a crashing shuttle, Teeseven fought beside his ally back to the ''Gravestone'' so they could flee the planet.<ref name="Chapter 8">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=8}}</ref>

===After the Empire===
{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught}}
After [[War against Zakuul|toppling the Eternal Empire]], Teeseven reunited with Kira and Scourge to confront Tenebrae for the [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|final time]].<ref name="Echoes">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=General|Echoes of Oblivion|[[Kira Carsen's ship]]}}</ref>

After her [[Mission to the Jedi Enclave|mission]] to the ruins of the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], Teeseven had a brief reunion with Aryn Leneer on [[Odessen]]. Aryn was pleased to discover that Teeseven had found a new home, and believed that Ven Zallow would have been happy for him as well.<ref name="ArynMail">{{TORcite|type=message|The path that lies ahead.|Aryn Leneer}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
T7-O1 is a companion character for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively-multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He first appeared in the ''[[Deceived]]'' cinematic trailer for the game, briefly warning Ven Zallow of the approach of Darth Malgus, and also appears in the related novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', which is set directly following the trailer. T7 would also appear in the third and final trailer for the game, [[Return (cinematic trailer)|''Return'']], in the service of Nico Okarr.

[[File:T7-O1_Lego.png|thumb|right|130px|T7-O1 in LEGO form]]
Like all other pages on the site, T7-O1's HoloNet page on the official ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' website features three phrases written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]. The first, "accidental slaver", refers to T7-O1's work with the slaver Shafu before the Rodian's change of heart, and the second, "Flesh Raider collectable", is an allusion to how T7-O1 is captured by Flesh Raiders just before the player encounters him in the mission "High-Tech Savages". The last phrase, "The Exploding Starships Conspiracy", refers to the work of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Terrin Sandafar]], who killed Shafu and the Alderaanian noble [[Eckhorn Baliss]] by setting their ships to explode at the orders of Senator Verre Sydia's husband.

T7-O1 also appears as a minifigure in a [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] set; namely [http://lego.wikia.com/wiki/9497_Republic_Striker_Starfighter 9497 Republic Striker Starfighter], a set composed of a [[Liberator-class starfighter|''Talon''-class Republic starfighter]] as well as a Republic trooper and Satele Shan as she appears in the [[Hope (cinematic trailer)|''Hope'' cinematic trailer]].

In the Imperial storyline, T7-O1 became conflicted regarding his loyalties concerning the Alliance after ''Jedi Under Siege'' because of the Alliance's perceived newfound alignment with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. However, T7-O1 elected to remain with the Commander.<ref name="Conflicted">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=message|T7-O1 <nowiki>=</nowiki> Conflicted|T7-O1}}</ref>
